# Allure Wellness & Esthetics

> Boutique medical spa and wellness clinic in Plantation, Florida (Broward County).

- Address: 8320 W Sunrise Blvd, Suite 211, Plantation, FL 33322
- Phone: 954-228-5034
- Booking: https://allure-wellness-and-esthetics.square.site/
- Team: Alicia Jimenez, board-certified APRN (medical oversight); Vanessa Gonzalez, NBHWC health coach (nutrition); Laritza Corrales, licensed esthetician.
- Serves: Plantation, Fort Lauderdale, Sunrise, Davie, Lauderhill, Weston, Tamarac.

## Treatments
- [Medical weight loss](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/medical-weight-loss): Prescription GLP-1 programs with a nurse practitioner, labs and nutrition coaching.
- [IV therapy & wellness injections](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/iv-therapy-wellness-injections): Mini IVs from $85, Brain Fuel, Immunity, Essential Glow, iron infusions and wellness shots.
- [HydraFacials & skin treatments](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/hydrafacials-skin-treatments): HydraFacial, boosters, microneedling and acne care, matched to your skin.
- [Body contouring · Venus Bliss MAX](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/body-contouring-venus-bliss-max): Non-surgical fat reduction, skin tightening and muscle stimulation in one device.
- [Nutrition & supplement programs](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/custom-supplements-nutrition-programs): One-on-one coaching, supplement protocols and testing with a board-certified health coach.
- [Functional lab testing](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/functional-lab-testing): Hormone, wellness, vitamin, peptide and gut panels, reviewed with you.
